spatialinversion.skill.spatial_link.desc: Create two connected spatial anchors. Projectiles and eligible objects entering one anchor emerge instantly from the other.
spatialinversion.skill.vector_redirect.d: Create a temporary directional spatial aperture that catches incoming projectiles and redirects their trajectory.
Invert the spatial coordinates of yourself and target entity, instantly swapping positions. Destination must be safe; bosses resist.
Generate a 6-block radius spatial curvature field around yourself that deflects and bends incoming projectile trajectories away.
Tear a spatial aperture and strike through the folded dimension, causing a concentrated dimensional burst at the target location.
spatialinversion.skill.fold_step.desc: Fold Euclidean space between two points and traverse through the shortcut instantly up to 16 blocks away.
spatialinversion.skill.spatial_cage.desc: Erect up to four interconnected planar spatial barriers enclosing an 8-block zone, redirecting escaping projectiles and containing foes.
spatialinversion.skill.absolute_inversio: Deploy two massive spatial inversion manifolds reversing the relationship between their areas. Catches and inverts enemy attacks across 30 blocks.
